title: Review a small change
summary: A focused review checks whether a change solves its stated problem and keeps the code readable. Small changes are easier to inspect.
introduction: A focused review checks whether a change solves its stated problem and keeps the code readable. Small changes are easier to inspect. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A focused review checks whether a change solves its stated problem and keeps the code readable. Small changes are easier to inspect.

blocks.code:
const trimTitle = title => title.trim();
console.log(trimTitle("  Moon  ") === "Moon");
blocks.title: Review a small change

blocks.text: The check passes. The change has one purpose: removing spaces at the ends.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a check showing spaces inside a title are preserved.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Avoid unrelated rewrites while fixing one small issue.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
